subtitle: Royal Classic Kitchen
summary: A Royal Classic kitchen in warm ivory with antique gold detailing.

texts.heading: Design Concept
texts.body: A luxurious Royal Classic kitchen by LUBE Italian, defined by timeless Italian craftsmanship, symmetry, refined ornamentation, and a warm ivory palette. The design combines elegant carved details, classical mouldings, and functional layout to create a sophisticated and enduring kitchen for a residential project in Dubai.

texts.heading: Handles & Hardware
items: Antique brass / champagne-gold classic pull handles and decorative knobs, matching the Royal Classic style.

texts.heading: Worktop & Splashback

Splashback: dark grey stone or quartz (proposed specification).
